title: Build shared admin primitives
description: Implement reusable admin shell and component primitives before frame-specific UI.
objective: Create the stable component base for Admin V0.2 without starting from CSS-only frame matching.
acceptance_criteria: Existing saving, nonce, capability, sanitization, and escaping patterns are preserved.
Components are reusable across Filter, CPT, and Integrations areas.
No new runtime dependency is added without a decision record.
verification: Open admin page without PHP fatal errors.
Implemented shared AdminPrimitives and rewired AdminPages to render the Admin V0.2 shell for Dashboard, Filters, CPTs, and Integrations.
PHP lint passed for includes/Admin/AdminPages.php and includes/Admin/AdminPrimitives.php via Docker wpcli PHP 8.3.
Plugin is active in local WordPress; WP-CLI render smoke returned dashboard:ok, filters:ok, cpts:ok, integrations:ok.
Playwright desktop verified the Filter Preset shell, preview modal, and 0 console errors.
Playwright mobile 390x900 verified no document horizontal overflow and 0 console errors.
git diff --check passed for root and plugin repos; no runtime save handlers, REST routes, CPT registration, widget behavior, or new dependencies were introduced.

budgets.validation_budget: WP admin smoke test plus code lint

risks: A broad component rewrite could break existing saves.
CSS-only implementation could create fragile visual matches.
